As I progressed, he steadily introduced more advanced skills such as complex roundabouts, dual carriageways, lane discipline, meeting oncoming traffic on narrow roads, and safe joining and exiting from junctions. What I appreciated most was how personalised his teaching was. Even in an automatic car, Rizwan Sir focused on helping me judge speed, timing, and gap selection, as well as managing braking and acceleration smoothly to keep the drive comfortable and safe. His feedback was always honest but encouraging, and he treated every mistake as a learning opportunity instead of something to be embarrassed about, which really boosted my confidence. Rizwan Sir also focused a lot on real test conditions and real-life UK driving. We practised test- style routes and key manoeuvres such as parallel parking, bay parking, and pull up on the right with reverse, as well as independent driving using road signs and sat nav. He always explained not just what to do, but why it matters for safety, consistency, and good habits after the test. Because of his guidance in an automatic car, I now feel far more confident driving in the UK
